name: QA panes
description: QA only (graph-integrity G5): a region of two panes (beside the chat and the sidebar), each hosting the chat dropped on it from the sidebar (the app's rows or the framework's); which chat is in which pane is this mod's own data, kept in its storage and restored at start; commands that move the keyboard between the panes of a window; a turn's steps unfolded and the app's command steps expanded by default.
